svg.desc: Role: Backend & Embedded C++ Developer. Focus: .NET, Embedded C++, Web & Databases. Base: Dai Dung Corporation - DDC. Class: Holy Knight · Light. Awakened: 2024-04-21. Software Engineer at Dai Dung Corporation. Building scalable .NET/C# backends, MES/ERP workflows, microservices & Embedded C++ systems. BE & Embedded Developer at Dai Dung Corp (11/2026 – now); Packaging MES · Thesis at Pika Tech & Analysis · FPTU (10/25 – 06/26); UniTaste Startup Project at FPT University (FPTU) (07/25 – 10/25); Claim Request System at FPT Software (01/25 – 07/25) Equipped C#, TypeScript, HTML. Inventory: .NET, C++, C, OpenJDK, ESP32, STM32, Arduino, PlatformIO, React, HTML, CSS, Postman, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Supabase, Firebase, Render, Git, GitHub. 2026-11-27: cleared 2 of 3 (Make one contribution 1 / 1, Commit to any repository 1 / 1, Open an issue: a bug, an idea, a question 0 / 1). Weekly boss 1 of 4 days. Today: Make one contribution, Keep MP at 14 (14 days), Star a repository you like. 148 active days in the last year rise as shadow soldiers; 12 days with 10 or more contributions become elites. AMMS: A Custom B2C Manufacturing Execution System for Dai Phuc Hai Packaging. 0 stars, 0 forks, C#. UniTasteApp: A microservice to import, sync, and manage restaurant data from Google Places, including photos, ratings, categories, and user reviews.
